comparison.objective: Crack a walnut with a hand nutcracker and sort kernel from shell.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply opposing forces to two tool handles, then manipulate and sort fragments; no precision setting is preserved against locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Walnut cracked, kernel placed in the bowl, shell placed on the saucer, and arms returned; all three versions were read.
comparison.reason: Opposing-force bimanual operation is generic and does not establish overlap with screw/jam-nut adjustment.
